author: Animalogic
description:
What if mammals had lost the battle for survival against dinosaurs? How did tiny, cat-sized ancestors evolve into giant bears, and why have crabs evolved into crab-like forms so many times? From horse-like crocodiles to lion-sized otters and bizarre prehistoric elephants, discover the evolutionary twists that shaped the animals we know today.

00:05 - Why Did Mammals Beat Dinos?
29:42 - The K-T Event: The Day We Said Good-Bye to the Dinos
36:38 - How Bears Went From Cat Sized To Car Sized
46:36 - Why Crabs Are Evolution on Steroids, 5 Separate Times
56:39 - The Crocs That Ran Like Horses
1:03:35 - Proailurus: The World's First Cat
1:08:44 - When Otters Were Lion Sized
1:17:16 - When Elephants Got Weird
